name: M3Exam
description: M3Exam is a multilingual, multimodal, multilevel benchmark for evaluating LLMs using real human exam questions from multiple countries. It covers 9 languages, 3 education levels (elementary, middle, high school), and includes both text-only and multimodal questions with images. Questions are from official school/university entrance exams.
typical_sota_score: ~70-80% (varies widely by language; English highest, low-resource languages lowest)
reputation: NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks; cross-cultural educational benchmark; tests LLMs across diverse languages and educational levels with real exam questions
notes: Published at NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks track. Covers Chinese, English, Italian, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Thai, Javanese, Swahili, and Afrikaans. Three education levels: elementary, middle, and high school. ~30% of questions include images. Exposes significant performance disparities across languages, highlighting challenges for multilingual LLMs.
